{07 14 00}Don't you think{01 00 00 0a 00} excavating
fossils is kind of like
finding love, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}You look and you look,{01 00 00 0a 00} and
once you find something
that you really like, 
{07 14 00}you want to display it for
all the world to see,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}! Am I right?

{07 19 00}I don't think fossils{01 00 00 05 00} feel
bad about being dug up
by me, {04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}I think of it as, like,{01 00 00 14 00} a
fated encounter that has
transcended centuries!

{07 19 00}Iron men of fossil hunting{01 00 00 0a 00}
will get down and listen to
the dirt, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}You know, {01 00 00 0a 00}I'll bet
that sound would be worth
more than the fossils!

{07 0b 00}Check out my ensemble here,
OK? {01 00 00 0a 00}Does it say to you I'm
searching for...{02 01 00 0a 0b 0c}
Fossils?
Love?
My true self?

{07 14 00}They say{01 00 00 0a 00} this is the most
effective way to walk,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{ff 00 00 07}shovel{ff 00 00 00}, I'm working my arms
as well as my legs!

{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It's weird. I'm actually not
that interested in fossils{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 19 00}But I think balance is the
key to life, so I want to
try a variety of hobbies!

{07 09 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I'm just making small talk,
{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 15 00} Sheesh!

chat going, and you aren't
exactly a sparkling wit.

out of that one,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}? Now that's wit!
